Features.Title: Startup after Month Close is fixed
Features.Description: HISAB KITAB now opens after a completed month is closed. Startup cleanup leaves closed-month records untouched and only repairs missing legacy values in editable records. Closed months remain protected, and the next month remains available for normal entries.

Features.Title: Month Close does not require license activation
Features.Description: A closed-month database protection message is no longer treated as a license or connection repair request. Your saved license and connection settings are retained. You do not need to reopen a closed month or re-enter a license because of Month Close.
